depiction.primary_object: hollow block arrow pointing up above a horizontal bar
depiction.composition: centered vertical arrangement, outline arrow over solid bar

ambiguity: Closely resembles the keyboard symbol for Caps Lock (or Shift with an underline) due to the hollow blocky arrow shape, as well as standard file upload icons.

modifier_semantics.meaning: base surface or origin from which something is uploaded, or locked state (Caps Lock)

task_intents: back up local data to cloud

reasoning: Shows a thick hollow upward arrow over a horizontal bar, universally read as 'upload' (and also used on keyboards for Caps Lock). It fits action-centered tasks where uploading, submitting, or publishing files to a portal or server is the core point of the task, though whenever the document type itself is more salient (e.g. passport, tax form, video), that object icon may compete.
